title: The specified derived open-pullback composition map
statement: For schemes X and X′, g′:X′→X, an open U⊆X, and K in the specified scheme derived category of X, let T=X′×X U with projections p:T→X′ and q:T→U. The openRestrictedCompositionMap is the morphism Lq*Lj*K→Lp*L(g′)*K obtained by the chosen derived pullback composition comparison for (q,j), then equality transport along q;j=p;g′, then the inverse chosen comparison for (p,g′). It is literally the morphism previously written inline as β; it introduces no new choice or axiom.

lean.statement:
def openRestrictedCompositionMap
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K) ⟶
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι)).obj ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
